rendered:
The paper reports limits of detection (LOD) as OD600 values. It also says CD reached a lower LOD than UV–vis in both cases.

- P. aeruginosa: 0.0034[1] by CD and 0.0066[2] by UV–vis.
- L. monocytogenes: 0.0123[3] by CD and 0.0125[4] by UV–vis.

For P. aeruginosa, the CD limit is about 1.94[5] times lower than the UV–vis limit, so it is roughly half. I worked this out by dividing the UV–vis LOD by the CD LOD; the paper does not state the factor itself. For L. monocytogenes, the CD and UV–vis limits are almost the same.
